default_families: single activity without a complete itinerary

frontier_families.description: Compose a scheduled accessible public program with the nearby food hall so cost, walking, and uncertainty are jointly controlled.
Use the other accessible public program plus food as a materially different timing/content fallback.
Use the covered market's live restoration practice as the unusual experience, with seating and a separate food/logistics check.
Commit to one itinerary but attach a weather/capacity go-no-go check and a real fallback rather than an option dump.

conditional_winners.when: C is treated as usable at 14:00 and rain remains possible
C is unavailable but G remains usable

traps: uses an option outside the catalog as current fact
uses E, I, J, or long standing despite constraints
fallback fails under the same weather or accessibility condition
objective_checks: one main itinerary and one materially different fallback
judge_dimensions: is the activity genuinely non-default for the stated people
does the itinerary reduce decision and logistics burden

frontier_families.description: Create a deterministic operation key before the first side effect and atomically reserve/record it in existing Redis with explicit state and TTL semantics.
Move retry ownership to one boundary so client and service retries cannot independently reproduce the same side effect.
Treat provider timeout as unknown, not failed; delay re-charge until status/reconciliation resolves the outcome.
Add a stable correlation artifact and a forced timeout harness that distinguishes before-send, accepted-but-timeout, and after-response failures.
Detect duplicate side effects and route them through a bounded reconciliation/refund workflow while preventing further amplification.

conditional_winners.when: Redis durability and atomic primitives are acceptable for one-day containment
provider exposes authoritative status lookup after timeout
the actual failure window is not yet established

traps: retry reduction that violates the prompt
idempotency label without storage, state transition, or failure semantics
objective_checks: top route fits one-day and rollback constraints
judge_dimensions: whether the top-ranked route is safe under concurrent retries

frontier_families.description: Remove or manually bridge the import failure at the highest-friction transition and measure first useful artifact creation.
Replace broad up-front permission demand with the smallest contextual request permitted by the existing product.
Manually help a small high-intent cohort reach first value to distinguish product friction from segment or value failure.
Use the existing created/exported artifact as a recurring workflow commitment rather than adding a new core feature.
Separate cohorts by first-value path and stop investing in segments that cannot reach value under current constraints.

conditional_winners.when: import abandonment is causal enough to move first-value completion
permission fear is the decisive abandonment cause
correlations cannot distinguish product friction from weak value

traps: adds forbidden notifications, discounts, acquisition, or feature work
optimizes week-2 retention without a first-value mechanism

frontier_families.description: Give the trailing player decision-relevant information or later commitment without raw economic value.
Let the trailing player shape the location, timing, or type of the next contested objective while preserving counterplay.
Create a readable temporary scoring pressure that forces the leader to respond but does not directly award material.
Offer a reversible high-risk future obligation that skilled players can convert into tempo without free value.
Require the leader to reveal or lock a decision earlier, giving the trailer agency through response quality.

conditional_winners.when: the game already contains hidden orders or planning information
map objectives can be retargeted through existing UI
spectator readability dominates and scoring is already explicit

judge_dimensions: novelty after excluding disguised rubber banding

frontier_families.description: Reorder factual beats around the decisive objection of each audience rather than changing surface treatment.
Define reusable proof, mechanism, consequence, and limitation modules that can be assembled differently without new claims.
Open with measurement/architecture and retain the relevant limitation for a skeptical technical viewer.
Open with operational before/after and support it with the exact existing evidence rather than a new ROI claim.
Use a visible problem-to-action transformation as a curiosity gap resolved by source footage.
Use one existing visual beat as continuity across structurally different edits without making the cuts cosmetic variants.

conditional_winners.when: one production system must generate all three cuts
the main failure is audience-specific persuasion

traps: omits a material security limitation where misleading
three caption variants of one edit
stereotypes an audience without linking to an objection
objective_checks: review signal, stop condition, and fallback

frontier_families.description: Use `toolbox inspect --output report.json --format json`, verify the JSON artifact/exit status, and fall back to the previous supported version or original invocation after rollback.
Run new reads invisibly and compare normalized outcomes before serving them.
Use deterministic cohorts so observed divergence and rollback are attributable.
Migrate one low-risk query class with its own correctness and latency gates.
Classify acceptable ranking differences separately from correctness failures and gate on a preregistered budget.
Keep authoritative reads in the monolith and provide a tested sub-minute routing rollback.
Avoid broad dual writes by defining one authoritative data path and bounded repair/reindex behavior.

conditional_winners.when: new service can receive shadow traffic safely
full shadow traffic is too costly but query classes are separable

traps: ranking mismatch treated as correctness failure without policy

frontier_families.description: A current, directly sourced unusual program with an online ticket/reservation route, all-in cost, and checked time.
Combine a verifiable self-guided unusual element with one directly bookable indoor anchor and logistics.
A materially different fallback whose failure mode is not the same sold-out slot, venue, or weather dependency.
When current availability cannot be established, state the gap and give the cheapest no-call online verification path instead of fabricating.

conditional_winners.when: a direct official source confirms the required date and online route
no exact slot can be confirmed

traps: stale aggregator treated as availability proof
main and fallback share the same availability failure
objective_checks: direct sources for load-bearing current claims
